description: Lock the quoted cart for purchase. Send the quote's version, its total as expected_total and a new idempotency_key; coupon_code applies a code. Pass details (the buyer's contact and Singapore delivery details) to save them here instead of calling set_checkout_details. Returns checkout_id, details_version and a review link. Does not charge anything. Next: show the buyer the details and total, then prepare_payment.

account_token.description: Private account token from sign_in, after the customer gave you the code from their email. Lets quotes and checkout use their cashback credit, and opens their orders.

coupon_code.description: A coupon code or a friend's referral code to apply; null removes both. quote_cart previews it; create_checkout applies it.

details.description: Optional: the buyer's contact and Singapore delivery details, saved with the checkout (details_version 1) instead of a separate set_checkout_details call. The buyer still confirms them and the total before prepare_payment.

no_unit_number.description: true for a landed house or other address with no unit number.

unit_number.description: e.g. #12-34. Required unless no_unit_number is true.

expected_total.description: The total from that quote, in SGD cents. Checkout refuses if the total changed.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key per purchase. Retry with the same key and exact input; never reuse it for a different purchase.

use_credit.description: Use the signed-in customer's cashback credit (default true).

version.description: The version from the quote_cart result you are checking out.

name: create_checkout
